name: Data display
description: Presenting content. These are reading surfaces: Haze fills carry them, text stays crisp, and no fill is ever feathered across a glyph.

components.name: Card
components.anatomy: A Haze content surface with optional media, header, body and action row.
components.material: Haze, 80% fill with a 1.95px feathered perimeter
components.geometry: Content radius; at least 12px between content and the feathered edge
components.semantics: An article when it is content, a button when the whole card acts. Never both.
components.product: Content and what an interactive card does
components.note: A card-shaped button keeps the content radius rather than the action pill, so its artwork is not clipped.

components.name: Table
components.anatomy: A Resin-rimmed shell over Haze, a sticky header band, hairline row separators and a scrolling body.
components.material: Resin shell, Haze fill, primary-soft header
components.geometry: Content radius shell; header corners inset 8px; 14px/18px cells
components.semantics: Real table semantics with header associations; sort controls are buttons carrying aria-sort
components.crystal: Shell, header band, separators, sticky behaviour, reduced-effect fallbacks
components.product: Data, sorting, pagination and selection behaviour

components.name: Data table
components.anatomy: Table anatomy with sorting, filtering, selection, column sizing and pagination.
components.material: Shared with Table; selection uses the leading rail, not a check badge on the row
components.geometry: Shared with Table
components.semantics: aria-sort on sorted headers; row selection through real checkboxes with names
components.crystal: All Table treatment plus sort, filter and selection appearance
components.product: The data layer, virtualisation, and the sorting and filtering implementation

components.name: List
components.anatomy: Ordered or unordered rows with optional leading media and trailing actions.
components.material: Haze rows on the surrounding surface
components.geometry: Content radius on rows; separators are hairlines
components.semantics: Real list semantics; interactive rows are buttons or links, not clickable divs
components.product: Content, virtualisation and row actions

components.name: Description list
components.anatomy: Term and value pairs in a two-column or stacked arrangement.
components.material: Haze panel when grouped
components.geometry: Content radius; term column aligned to the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Real definition-list semantics so term and value stay associated
components.product: The data

components.name: Avatar
components.anatomy: A circular image, initials or icon, with an optional status indicator.
components.material: Surface-alt fill behind initials; 2px surface ring for separation
components.geometry: Always circular; sizes on the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Decorative avatars are aria-hidden; identifying avatars carry the person's name
components.product: Real identity, image loading and the fallback source

components.name: Avatar group
components.anatomy: Overlapping avatars with an overflow count.
components.material: Shared with Avatar
components.geometry: -7px overlap; overflow chip matches avatar size
components.semantics: The group has one accessible name; the overflow count is announced, not implied
components.product: Who is shown and the overflow threshold

components.name: Badge
components.anatomy: A small count or label attached to a host element.
components.material: Resin shell with Haze fill; status badges use their semantic ink pair
components.geometry: Pill or circle; never smaller than legible
components.semantics: The count reaches assistive technology through the host's accessible name or a live region
components.product: The count and when it is meaningful

components.name: Status badge
components.anatomy: A semantic symbol in a circular well, followed by a visible word.
components.material: Tested semantic ink and surface pair behind the symbol; never a coloured perimeter stroke
components.geometry: Pill; 24px symbol well; 36px minimum height
components.semantics: The word carries the meaning. Symbol and colour are reinforcement, never the only signal.
components.crystal: Symbol vocabulary, tested colour pairs, geometry
components.product: Which status applies and the wording
components.note: Success uses a check mark. That is information display — the legitimate use of the glyph.

components.name: Indicator
components.anatomy: A small circular Resin mark attached to a control, carrying state.
components.material: Resin shell with a 3px-inset Haze fill and a 1px feather on that fill
components.geometry: 20px, or 24px on fields; never a click target
components.semantics: aria-hidden. The real control supplies the state; the mark only shows it.
components.crystal: The complete mark vocabulary and its precedence
components.product: Nothing; this is entirely system-owned
components.note: Selection resolves to a leading rail, not a badge. A check mark is not in this vocabulary.

components.name: Image
components.anatomy: Media with a reserved ratio, a loading placeholder and a failure fallback.
components.material: Haze placeholder while loading
components.geometry: Content radius when clipped; never distorts aspect
components.semantics: Meaningful images carry alt text; decorative images carry empty alt
components.product: Sources, sizing and alt text

components.name: Timeline
components.anatomy: Ordered events on a connector with per-event markers.
components.material: Resin markers on a Haze connector
components.geometry: Circular markers; 2px connector
components.semantics: Ordered list; the current item carries aria-current
components.crystal: Marker and connector treatment, state appearance
components.product: Events and their ordering

components.name: Accordion
components.anatomy: Disclosure rows with a header control, a rotating chevron and a content region.
components.material: Haze rows; expanded content shares the row surface
components.geometry: Content radius; header meets 44px
components.semantics: Header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; content is not hidden from search when collapsed unless intended
components.crystal: Row treatment, chevron rotation, expansion appearance
components.product: Single or multiple expansion policy and content

components.name: Collapse
components.anatomy: A height transition revealing or hiding a region.
components.material: Inherits
components.geometry: Inherits
components.semantics: The trigger carries aria-expanded; hidden content is genuinely hidden from assistive technology
components.product: Trigger and content

components.name: Spoiler
components.anatomy: Content truncated to a height with a reveal control and an edge fade.
components.material: Edge fade drawn from the surrounding material
components.geometry: Fade depth 24px
components.semantics: The control carries aria-expanded; truncated text remains in the accessibility tree
components.product: Threshold and content

components.name: Carousel
components.anatomy: A scrolling track of slides with previous and next controls and position indicators.
components.material: Resin controls floating over Haze slides
components.geometry: Content radius slides; pill controls meeting 44px
components.semantics: role=group with an accessible name; indicators are buttons; never autoplay without a pause control
components.crystal: Slide and control treatment, indicator appearance
components.product: Slides, scroll behaviour and autoplay policy

components.name: Statistic
components.anatomy: A large value with a label and an optional trend indicator.
components.material: Haze panel when grouped into a row
components.geometry: Content radius; tabular figures
components.semantics: Trend direction is stated in text, not by colour or arrow alone
components.product: The value, formatting and what the trend compares

components.name: Code
components.anatomy: Inline or block monospace content with an optional copy action.
components.material: Canvas fill with an edge rim; never feathered, as code must stay exact
components.geometry: 14px radius inline, content radius for blocks
components.semantics: Real code and pre elements; blocks are focusable when scrollable
components.product: Highlighting and content

components.name: Keyboard key
components.anatomy: A small raised key cap representing a physical key.
components.material: Resin cap with a defined lower rim
components.geometry: 8px radius; compact but legible
components.semantics: Real kbd element; key names are spelled, not drawn as symbols alone
components.product: The key names

components.name: Theme icon
components.anatomy: An icon in a filled container, used as a visual anchor rather than an action.
components.material: Primary-soft or surface-alt fill
components.geometry: Content radius or circle; 24px icon
components.semantics: Decorative and aria-hidden unless it is the only carrier of meaning
components.product: Which icon and what it anchors

components.name: Authored bubble
components.anatomy: A reading surface with one intentionally tightened corner indicating authorship or direction.
components.material: Haze; own messages use the primary-container pair
components.geometry: 6/22/22/22px incoming, 22/6/22/22px own, mirrored for right-to-left
components.semantics: Author and time are text, not implied by side alone
components.crystal: Silhouette, corner asymmetry, own and incoming pairs, mirroring
components.product: Delivery, grouping rules and failure recovery
components.note: This silhouette is part of Crystal's identity and carries through from the approved baseline.

components.name: Caption
components.anatomy: Descriptive text accompanying media, placed below or over the media surface.
components.material: Stone label backing when overlaid on media, so contrast does not depend on the image
components.geometry: Content radius when overlaid; 12px inset from the media edge
components.semantics: Real figure and figcaption. A caption never replaces alt text; the two say different things.
components.crystal: Backing material, placement and protected contrast
components.product: The caption text
